body.name: Joint OVS score vector
body.construction:
For \(k=(g,t)\in\mathcal K\) and \(c\in\mathcal J_k\), let
\(e_{a,s,k}(O)=\sum_{u=g}^t\{\Delta Y_u-m_{a,s,u}(X)\}\), and retain the uncentered ratio pseudo-outcome
\[
R_{k,c,P}(O)=\frac{1}{\pi_{g,1}}\left[\mathbf 1_{g,1}\{q_{k,c}(X)+e_{g,1,k}(O)\}-\frac{p_{g,1}(X)}{p_{g,0}(X)}\mathbf 1_{g,0}e_{g,0,k}(O)-\frac{p_{g,1}(X)}{p_{c,1}(X)}\mathbf 1_{c,1}e_{c,1,k}(O)+\frac{p_{g,1}(X)}{p_{c,0}(X)}\mathbf 1_{c,0}e_{c,0,k}(O)\right].
\]
The centered ratio-functional score is
\[
\Psi_{k,c,P}(O)=R_{k,c,P}(O)-\frac{\theta_k(P)}{\pi_{g,1}}\mathbf 1_{g,1}
=\frac{1}{\pi_{g,1}}\left[\mathbf 1_{g,1}\{q_{k,c}(X)-\theta_k(P)+e_{g,1,k}(O)\}-\frac{p_{g,1}(X)}{p_{g,0}(X)}\mathbf 1_{g,0}e_{g,0,k}(O)-\frac{p_{g,1}(X)}{p_{c,1}(X)}\mathbf 1_{c,1}e_{c,1,k}(O)+\frac{p_{g,1}(X)}{p_{c,0}(X)}\mathbf 1_{c,0}e_{c,0,k}(O)\right].
\]
Stack both vectors in the fixed order \(\mathcal I\).  The extra target-cell term is the derivative of the denominator \(\pi_{g,1}\); in particular, the former formula \(\Psi=R-A\theta\) is not the gradient of the ratio functional when \(\pi_{g,1}\) varies.
